---
title: Honest limits
description: What this build doesn't do yet, said plainly, and what comes next.
icon: TriangleExclamationPoint
---

- **Live has no recorded real-money payment yet.** Live is on (`tegata.near`, mainnet USDC, NEAR Intents), and every
  [proof](/docs/how-money-moves/proof) in these docs is on testnet. NEAR Intents has no testnet, so paying in from
  other chains and paying out to them haven't been walked end to end for these docs.
- **Wallet sign-in is testnet only.** A NEAR-wallet owner can use the Sandbox but can't open Live until a mainnet
  wallet can sign in; email owners can. Wallet sign-in itself is proved by a script playing the wallet (a real testnet
  account signing with its own key, as NEAR Connect's wallets do).
- **Autopilot is Sandbox-only.** Its contract is `pay.tegata.testnet`; on mainnet the Payroll page says it opens when
  the contract is deployed there. Autopilot pays Tegata and NEAR accounts only: a payout to another chain needs a
  fresh NEAR Intents quote, which can't be fetched with nobody online.
- **Bank runs in the Sandbox, on Noah's sandbox.** A withdrawal reaches Noah's last step and stops there, before any
  money moves, until Noah switches payouts on for Tegata's sandbox account; the page says so. In the Sandbox the USDC
  reaches Noah through Tegata's own Solana devnet wallet, where Live would use NEAR Intents. A person can't yet choose
  a bank account for their pay.
- **Cards and card payments wait on their partners' keys.** **Cards** says "Opening soon", and the Card way to pay
  stays hidden from payers until Bitnob's and Transak's keys are set. Transak's staging orders deliver nothing on NEAR,
  so in the Sandbox Tegata sends the matching test USDC itself, and the receipt says so.
- **A card reserve and a bank hop hold money for minutes.** Money on its way to a card or a bank passes through
  Tegata's operator account; everywhere else it moves from the business's own account
  ([Bank and cards](/docs/how-money-moves/bank-and-cards)).
- **The autopilot contract has no upgrade method, but its account does.** `pay.tegata.testnet`'s only key is the
  operator's, so during the hackathon Tegata can redeploy it.
- **A wallet owner gets no emails** unless the business sets a billing email: Tegata has no other address for them.
- **The Sandbox stash is shared.** Add test dollars and euro deposits in the Sandbox draw from Tegata's own test USDC
  and can run dry; Circle's faucet is the fallback for test dollars.
- **Referrals don't yet flag two accounts opened from one device or network.**
- **No outside businesses have used it yet.**

## Next

None of these is described anywhere in these docs as working:

| Next | What it adds |
| --- | --- |
| Partner keys | Bitnob's sandbox keys open spend cards; Transak's keys open paying and adding money by card |
| Noah payouts | Bank withdrawals that reach the bank, then Noah's business review for Live |
| Autopilot on mainnet | `pay.tegata.near`, so Live paydays can pay themselves |
| Mainnet wallet sign-in | NEAR-wallet owners in Live |
| A person's bank account | Payroll that lands in someone's own bank |
